description: This Java source file defines an abstract test class 'WithMockServers' for testing connectivity messaging in the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages mock server lifecycle across tests using JUnit annotations.

classes.name: WithMockServers
classes.description: An abstract test class that sets up mechanisms to stop mock servers after all tests are run, ensuring shared connections are correctly managed.

methods.name: stopMockServers
methods.description: Static method annotated with @AfterClass to stop mock servers after all tests, calling TestConstants.stopMockServers().
